subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose filesystem metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR chooses to expose metadata for external paths, while the existing Gateway helper intentionally keeps session-file stat/read behavior behind fs-safe workspace containment.

options.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the Missing-badge UX with filtering, a neutral external state, or another boundary-preserving representation.

options.title: Split UI Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Land or keep the layout fix separately while a focused backend PR settles external and directory semantics.

options.title: Accept External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow the metadata exposure only with explicit maintainer/security acceptance plus protocol and UI tests documenting the new contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the Missing-badge UX with filtering, a neutral external state, or another boundary-preserving representation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about a shared Gateway/security boundary, and Vincent has recent adjacent current-main history in the session-files/protocol area.
